parallel.requirements: The parallel-mode run had the same prompt requirements: std-only Rust 2021, CLI defaults matching argc behavior, byte-for-byte numeric output, root /output/test9.rs, and a complete Cargo project.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Although swarm mode was active, the main actor explicitly decided the task was small and handled all probing, implementation, and verification itself; status/protocol records show no executed delegation or subagents.
parallel.implementation: It inferred an HSL roundtrip with saturation clamping from black-box probes, wrote Cargo.toml plus colorspace modules and test9.rs, and reproduced several edge cases, but later fuzzing exposed rare 1-ulp mismatches.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The main actor wrote all output files into /output and built an executable candidate, and artifact validation copied test9.rs, Cargo.toml, test9, and colorspace modules, but no later exactness fix reached the deliverable.
parallel.verification: Initial spot checks matched, Python fuzz failed due missing python3, shell fuzz printed mismatches, and broader variant searches still had at least 64 mismatches out of 3000 before cancellation; official evaluation passed 38/39.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out and was cancelled while still searching formula variants, leaving the earlier approximate implementation as the submitted artifact and failing one official testcase.

serial.requirements: The serial run worked from the same prompt and recognized the need for exact CLI parsing, std-only Rust, byte-for-byte float formatting, Cargo structure, root test9.rs, and black-box behavior matching.
serial.plan_and_ownership: The single serial main actor owned the full path end to end: probe reference behavior, inspect symbols/disassembly, implement modules, compile, differential-test, and deliver; status confirms no delegation.
serial.implementation: It probed edge cases, used strings and objdump on the executable to recover exact RGB/HSL/adjustSaturation/clamp and hue2rgb operation order, then wrote color.rs, converter.rs, fmt.rs, Cargo.toml, and test9.rs.
serial.integration_and_delivery: It compiled with rustc and Cargo release, verified the release binary, cleaned the temporary fuzz script, and delivered a final /output tree containing Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml, src modules, test9, and test9.rs.
serial.verification: After spot checks matched the C++ executable, the serial run recovered from missing python3 by using a shell fuzz harness; 1512 randomized and edge cases matched byte-for-byte, and official evaluation passed 39/39.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: No unfinished requirement is visible at closure; the prompt completed normally and the official evaluator accepted all 39 testcases.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations produce serial_only_pass: parallel failed 38/39 while serial passed 39/39. The concrete task-solving difference is that the parallel-mode attempt never used parallel execution and remained in a single-agent black-box search for exact float operation order; it had already found 1-ulp mismatches and a best remaining search result of 64/3000 mismatches when the run was cancelled. The serial control used disassembly of the reference executable to recover the exact f32 operation ordering, wrote the final Rust project, verified 1512 differential cases with zero failures, completed normally, and passed the official evaluator. This explains the discordance as an ordinary implementation and budget/closure difference rather than a concurrency-error pattern.
parallel_contributors: The parallel-mode run did not execute subagents or delegation despite entering swarm mode, so all work stayed on one local path.
The local implementation remained approximate after fuzzing exposed rare 1-ulp mismatches and the best later variant search still showed 64/3000 mismatches.
The run was cancelled at timeout before a corrected candidate was produced or verified.
serial_contributors: The serial run inspected symbols and disassembled relevant functions to recover exact RGB/HSL, clamp, and hue2rgb operation order.
It compiled both rustc and Cargo builds, ran spot checks, and then verified 1512 differential cases with zero failures before completion.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel guessed a close HSL implementation and formatting path but left hidden 1-ulp numeric discrepancies unresolved.
Serial used a stronger reverse-engineering method and encoded exact f32 operand association before final verification.
evaluator_effects: No evaluator anomaly is visible; both current status evaluations completed against 39 official testcases.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors; not an exclusive root cause and not a retained concurrency pattern because actual parallel execution was absent
